create_Judgment: create a Judgment dataclass to record success status and event ID mappings for agent validation
create_ToolCallCountsFailure: create a ToolCallCountsFailure to report discrepancies between agent and oracle tool call counters
create_EventComparisonFailure: create an EventComparisonFailure to log why an agent event failed to match an oracle event
create_OracleEventMatchingFailure: create an OracleEventMatchingFailure to report when the agent skipped an oracle tool call
create_EnvOracleMatchingFailure: create an EnvOracleMatchingFailure to flag unmatched oracle environment or user events
